data.name: Red Rust Pioneers
data.detailed_description:
The year is 1842. Behind you, the life you knew. Ahead, the western frontier - miles of open sky, untouched valleys and adventure. Out here, the land is rich, the rivers run clean, and what you make of it is yours to keep. All you need is the frontier ahead, friends beside you, and the will to build a new life from the ground up.

The Wild West won't make it easy. But you didn't come out here for easy.

  • Build your homestead from a canvas tent to a ranch on the western frontier

  • Travel by wagon, break camp and push further west to settle new land

  • Hunt, fish and farm to feed yourself and your companions through every season

  • Craft tools, weapons and gear to carve out your place on the frontier

  • Survive blistering summers, violent storms and bitter frontier winters

  • Explore a vast open world alive with beauty, danger and discovery

  • Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op

Red Rust Pioneers brings together the deep survival crafting and base building of Valheim and The Forest with the rugged beauty of Red Dead Redemption 2, set on a living, breathing western frontier.

BUILD & SETTLE

You didn't come west just to survive.

You came to build something. A canvas tent becomes a cabin. A cabin becomes a homestead. A homestead becomes a ranch. With your own two hands and the hands of your companions, you'll build a new life in the wide open wilderness of Red Rust Valley, one timber frame and campfire at a time.

The frontier is free and it's waiting. What you make of it is up to you.

EXPLORE & ADVENTURE

The wilderness beyond your door is yours to explore.

Your homestead is your anchor. When you're ready, load your wagon, break camp, and ride out into the wilderness. New country reveals fresh resources, hidden valleys and breathtaking vistas you'll want to share with your companions. And when your saddlebags are full and the sun is dropping, there's nothing quite like the ride home, wagon loaded, ready to build something new.

Every expedition brings something back to make your homestead a little stronger, a little larger, a little more your own.

LIVE OFF THE LAND

But first, you have to survive it.

The Wild West doesn't care about your plans. Battle hunger, thirst, and the unforgiving elements as you forage, hunt, and fish to stay alive. Farm and harvest crops to build a self-sufficient camp. Venture into the mountains for the resources that'll give you an edge.

Master the seasons. Scorching summers, violent rainstorms and freezing winters stand between you and the life you're building. Respect the frontier, and it will reward you. Defy it, and the west has a long memory.

GOOD COMPANY

The trail is better with friends beside you.

Invite up to three friends into your world - split the work and share the adventure. Ride out into the wilderness, set up camp beneath the stars, and build a homestead and new life together. Red Rust Pioneers is built from the ground up for co-operative play, and the frontier is a better place for it.


The frontier is waiting. Your story starts here.

data.short_description: Build a new life in the Wild West open world of Red Rust Valley, alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. Hunt, farm, raise animals and craft through the changing seasons in this survival game as your camp grows from a canvas tent to a homestead. Free land, open skies, and a world worth exploring.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or above
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT and above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Red Rust Pioneers is in active development. System requirements may change as development continues and performance optimisations are applied. Players hosting co-op sessions should expect higher CPU and RAM usage. An SSD is strongly recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X or above
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Red Rust Pioneers is in active development. System requirements may change as development continues and performance optimisations are applied. Players hosting co-op sessions should expect higher CPU and RAM usage. An SSD is strongly recommended.
